data.credibility: Management guidance history is entirely unrepresented in the provided ledger, making direct tracking of past promises impossible from the text alone. However, current financial metrics show strong operational scale and near debt-free status.
bull: Revenue compounded at 27.2% annually over five years, reaching ₹1,254 crore with a robust EBITDA margin of 51.1%.
Operating cash flow reached 97% of reported profit over five years, confirming that earnings convert strongly into cash.
CDSL holds an 80% market share, crossing 18 crore demat accounts and 10 crore KYC records in FY 2025-26.
bear: EBITDA margin has narrowed noticeably from 61.6% in FY21 down to 50.8% in FY26.
Working-capital days stretched significantly from -110 to -32 over the past five years.
The valuation reflects high expectations, trading at a P/E multiple of 59.9 against a net profit of ₹504 crore.
